summary: Frontend-only, no-submit verification of tablet customer-name validation on /tablet (TabletOrder.jsx). Confirmed labels, canSubmit name-portion behavior, payload trimming, and absence of any tablet order / checkout / kitchen / printer network calls. NO order was submitted (real Pi printer attached).

verification_results.canSubmit_code: items.length>0 && form.first.trim() && form.phone.trim() && (pickup || address_fields) && !quote?.error — does NOT require form.last
verification_results.payload_submit_line_194_195: customer_first_name: form.first.trim(), customer_last_name: form.last.trim() — trimmed value passed, empty string allowed (no placeholder like 'Client')
verification_results.quote_payload_line_157_158: customer_first_name: form.first || 'Client', customer_last_name: form.last || '' — quote-only placeholder for empty first (does NOT affect the submit/order payload)

critical_code_review_comments: In the quote-fetch useEffect (lines 157-158) customer_first_name falls back to 'Client' when form.first is empty. This is only used for the price quote (not final order) so it does not violate the requirement, but confirm with product that a 'Client' quote placeholder is intentional; the submit payload correctly uses .trim() with no placeholder.
